articles.title: The King's Cart Stops at the Scale
articles.summary: A king sets a weight limit to protect an old bridge; the next year, the first heavy cart stopped comes from the palace.
articles.summaryZh: 国王为保护旧桥定下车重上限，第二年，第一辆被拦下的重车来自王宫。
storyParagraphs: After heavy carts cracked the stone bridge, the king issued a rule: every vehicle would be weighed before crossing, and anything above the limit had to unload. The rule appeared at the bridge and instructed guards not to vary inspection by status.

The following spring, a palace convoy carried stone for a banquet. Its first cart drove the scale beyond the limit. The royal steward ordered passage, saying the king's affairs could not wait. The guard pointed to the posted words but feared losing his office for stopping a royal vehicle.

An independent reviewer arrived that day. The steward could request an emergency exception, but had to state its legal basis, scope, and duration and leave a record open to review. Banquet stone was not an emergency. The request failed. The king did not remove the guard; he ordered half the stone unloaded and sent across in two journeys.

Months later, an overweight flood-rescue cart crossed under a published emergency clause and received a later bridge-damage inspection. The exception rested not on one person's command but on a prior rule and later review.
When the palace convoy next reached the bridge, the steward first handed over the cargo sheet. The king's cart waited at the scale with every other vehicle.
storyParagraphsZh: 石桥被重车压裂后，国王颁布规则：所有过桥车辆先称重，超过上限必须卸货。规则写在桥头，也规定守桥人的检查不得因身份不同而改变。
第二年春天，王宫车队运送宴会石材。第一辆车压下秤杆，超过上限。车队总管命守桥人放行，说国王的事务不能等待。守桥人指向桥头的文字，却仍担心因阻拦王车失去职位。
独立审理官当天赶来。总管可以申请紧急例外，但须说明法律依据、范围和期限，并留下可复核记录。宴会石材并不紧急，申请被驳回。国王得知后没有撤换守桥人，而是让王车卸下一半石料分两次通过。
几个月后，洪水救援车也超重。它依据公开的紧急条款获准通行，随后接受桥梁损伤检查。例外并非靠某个人一句话，而受事先规则和事后审查约束。
王宫车队再次来到桥头时，总管先把货单递给守桥人。国王的车与其他车辆一起停在秤前。
explanationParagraphs: The rule of law requires public power to operate through accessible, predictable, and generally applicable rules, supported by independent review, access to justice, and effective remedy against arbitrariness. Emergency power can be compatible with it when grounded in law and constrained by scope, time, records, and review rather than status alone.
explanationParagraphsZh: 法治要求公共权力依照可获得、可预见且普遍适用的规则行使，并以独立审查、司法可及与有效救济抵抗任意权力。紧急权力并非必然违背法治，但应有明确依据、范围、期限、记录和复核，而不能只凭身份决定。

articles.title: The Sentence Beneath the First Bridge
articles.summary: An old case leaves five words, 'the bridge opener pays', and years later nearly prevents a rescue.
articles.summaryZh: 一桩旧案留下“开桥者赔偿”五个字，许多年后，它几乎阻止了一次救援。
storyParagraphs: Years earlier, a bridge owner raised a drawbridge at night to collect boat fees and caused a cart to fall into the water. The court ordered compensation, writing: 'A person who knowingly opens a bridge for private gain while travellers are crossing bears the resulting loss.' Later readers shortened this to five words: the bridge opener pays.

Many years later, a keeper raised the bridge for a fireboat after receiving an alarm. A cargo cart ignored the barrier and struck the gate. Its owner cited the old case and demanded payment from the keeper. If only the five words were read, the cases looked identical.

The judge obtained the full first decision. What it had needed to resolve was a danger created without warning and for private gain. Opening a bridge was not an act that produced liability without its facts. The new case involved an alarm, barrier, and public rescue.

The judge explained why the old case did not control the new one rather than pretending it did not exist. The keeper did not pay for the cart, although the bridge office was required to raise its low barrier. The earlier decision remained in force; it had simply not decided this situation.
When filing the case, the judge unfolded the full page that had been tucked behind the five quoted words.
storyParagraphsZh: 多年前，桥主为收取夜船费，擅自升起吊桥，导致一辆马车落水。法庭判他赔偿，判词里写着：“明知道路有人通行而为私利开桥者，应承担损失。”后来人常把它缩成五个字：开桥者赔偿。
许多年后，一名守桥人为让救火船通过，在得到警报后升桥。一辆无视拦绳的货车撞上桥门。车主拿出旧案，要求守桥人照样赔偿。若只读那五个字，两案似乎完全相同。
法官调来第一案全文。旧判决真正需要解决的是桥主在无警示、为私利的情况下制造危险；“开桥”不是脱离事实便自动产生责任的动作。新案有警报、拦绳和公共救援，关键事实不同。
法官说明旧案为何不直接控制本案，而不是假装它不存在。守桥人不承担货车损失，桥务处却因拦绳过低被要求改进。旧判决仍然有效，只没有被拉到它从未决定的地方。
归档时，法官把那五个字旁边被折进去的整页判词重新展开。
explanationParagraphs: Precedent uses earlier judicial decisions to guide later cases. Binding force depends on court hierarchy, jurisdiction, material facts, and the holding necessary to resolve the original issue; not every sentence carries equal authority. Courts may distinguish materially different cases or, with authority and reasons, overrule an earlier rule.
explanationParagraphsZh: 判例原则以较早司法决定指导后来案件。约束力取决于法院层级、管辖、关键事实和解决原争点所必要的核心裁断，而非每一句话都同等有效。法院可在重大事实不同时区分案件，也可由有权法院明确推翻旧规则。

articles.title: The Missing Sack of Grain
articles.summary: One sack disappears from the granary, and the manager orders the last worker to prove he did not take it.
articles.summaryZh: 仓库少了一袋粮，管事要求最后离开的人证明自己没有拿走它。
storyParagraphs: After the night shift, one sack of grain was missing from the public store. The manager suspected porter Zhou Qi because he had left last and was poor. He ordered Zhou Qi to prove within three days that he had not stolen it or repay the value and lose his job.

Zhou Qi could not prove an act he said he had never performed. He could only say the sack was present when he left, with no witness. The manager produced the empty space and exit record and called the suspicion sufficient.

The reviewer first asked who made the theft claim and who should bear the loss if both sides had equally insufficient evidence. The granary controlled keys, counts, and gate records and was better placed to preserve evidence. It therefore had to produce material strong enough to support the accusation.

Further inspection found a skipped line in the count and a rear key shared among three people. Mistake or removal by someone else could not be excluded. The reviewer did not declare Zhou Qi certainly innocent, only that the evidence was insufficient to impose the consequence of theft.
The sack remained missing during the recount. The manager added two signatures to the new inventory sheet and did not fill the blank with Zhou Qi's name.
storyParagraphsZh: 夜班结束后，公仓少了一袋粮。管事认定搬运工周启最可疑，因为他最后离开，又家境贫寒。他命周启在三日内证明自己没有偷，否则照价赔偿并离职。
周启无法证明一个自己没有做过的动作。他只能说离开时粮袋还在，却没有证人。管事则拿出空位和出门记录，认为怀疑已经足够。
审理人先问是谁提出偷窃主张，也问如果双方证据一样不足，损失应落在谁身上。公仓掌握钥匙、清点表和守门记录，比搬运工更有能力保存证据，因此必须先拿出足以支持指控的材料。
进一步检查发现清点表前后差一行，后门锁也曾由三人共用。证据不能排除误记或他人取走。审理人没有宣布周启必然清白，只裁定现有材料不足以让他承担偷窃后果。
公仓补做盘点时，那一袋粮仍未找到。管事在新表上增加双人签名，没有再把空白处写成周启的名字。
explanationParagraphs: The burden of proof determines who must produce evidence and persuade a decision-maker, and who loses on an issue when evidence is absent or evenly balanced, together with the applicable standard of proof. Allocation varies by proceeding and jurisdiction. Difficulty proving a negative does not automatically transfer the ultimate burden to an accused person.
explanationParagraphsZh: 举证责任决定谁需提出证据、说服裁判者，以及证据不足或势均力敌时谁承担不利结果，并与具体证明标准共同运作。责任分配受程序、事项与管辖影响。不能因为被指控者难以证明否定事实，就自动把最终说服责任转给他。

articles.title: The Moths That Never Changed Colour
articles.summary: Light moths become rarer after the woods darken, yet a child never sees a single moth change its colour.
articles.summaryZh: 树林变暗以后，浅色蛾越来越少，孩子却始终没看到任何一只蛾改变颜色。
storyParagraphs: Tree trunks around Forest Town were once covered in pale lichen. Light moths were difficult to see there, while dark moths stood out. A naturalist recorded both colours each summer. As kilns spread along the town edge, soot gradually darkened the bark.

A child expected light moths to darken because they needed hiding. He watched for many days and saw none change. Light remained light and dark remained dark. What changed was how easily birds found individuals that contrasted with the bark.

The naturalist marked moths before returning them to the woods. In sooty areas, more dark moths survived to breed. In distant woodland where lichen remained, more light moths did. Colour could pass from parents to offspring, so the shares of the two colours differed in the next generation.

Later, cleaner kiln fuel allowed lichen to return. A colour favoured earlier no longer held the advantage everywhere. The forest had not moved toward a planned goal; environmental change altered the reproductive chances of inherited differences.
The child arranged years of specimens in one case. No pinned moth changed colour, yet the number of each colour shifted from row to row.
storyParagraphsZh: 林镇的树干原本覆着浅灰地衣，浅色蛾停在上面很难发现，深色蛾却十分显眼。自然观察员每年夏天记录两种蛾的数量。镇边窑炉增多后，烟尘使树皮逐渐变黑。
一个孩子以为浅色蛾会因为需要隐藏而慢慢变深。他连续看了许多天，没有一只蛾改变颜色。浅色仍是浅色，深色仍是深色；不同的是，鸟更容易找到与树皮反差大的个体。
观察员给蛾做上小标记后放回树林。黑树区中，更多深色蛾活到繁殖季；仍有地衣的远林里，浅色蛾保留得更多。蛾色能够由亲代传给后代，下一代的两种颜色所占份额因此不同。
后来窑炉改用较少烟尘的燃料，地衣慢慢回来。先前有利的颜色不再在所有地方占优。树林没有朝一个预定目标前进，环境改变了不同遗传差异留下后代的机会。
孩子把多年标本并排放进盒中。没有一只标本在针下变色，盒里颜色的多少却一年年改变。
explanationParagraphs: Natural selection occurs when individuals differ in heritable traits and those differences produce different survival or reproductive outcomes in a particular environment, changing trait frequencies across generations. Individuals do not evolve because they need to, and selection has no predetermined goal. Mutation, drift, gene flow, and environmental change also shape evolution.
explanationParagraphsZh: 自然选择发生在个体具有可遗传差异，而这些差异在特定环境中带来不同生存或繁殖结果，使群体中性状频率跨世代改变。个体不会因需要而主动演化，选择也没有预定目标；突变、漂变、基因流动和环境变化等也会影响结果。

articles.title: The Greenhouse That Never Stood Still
articles.summary: The greenhouse temperature stays within a narrow range all day, so an apprentice assumes its windows and valves should stop moving.
articles.summaryZh: 温室里的温度整日保持在窄小范围，学徒因此误以为所有窗和阀门都不该再动。
storyParagraphs: A hilltop greenhouse raised seedlings that tolerated neither cold nor heat. The thermometer remained between two marks, and apprentice Lin An assumed the old gardener had discovered a perfect setting. Yet the furnace warmed at night, windows released daytime heat, and water valves and shades moved with the weather.

When the gardener left for a day, Lin An fixed the windows, furnace door, and water valves in their morning positions to 'keep things stable'. Clouds cleared before noon and sunlight intensified. The temperature crossed the upper mark and leaves began to droop. The number had appeared steady only because many parts kept changing.

Lin An opened the roof window, shaded the sunny wall, and reduced the fire. When the temperature fell too far, he narrowed the opening again. The thermometer showed a departure and action pulled it back toward the useful range; action that was late or excessive produced swings.

He later adjusted shades before expected weather changes and recorded growth stage, since a range suitable for seedlings did not always suit flowering plants. The greenhouse had no setting that remained correct forever, only continuing sensing, comparison, and response.
When the old gardener returned, the thermometer still sat between the marks. Lin An was opening the roof window another finger's width.
storyParagraphsZh: 山顶温室培育怕冷又怕热的幼苗。温度表整日只在两条刻线之间移动，学徒林安以为老园丁已经找到了完美设置。夜里炉火加温，白天窗户放热，水阀和遮帘也随天气不断变化。
老园丁外出一天，林安为了“保持稳定”，把窗、炉门和水阀固定在清晨的位置。上午云散，阳光突然增强。温度很快越过上限，幼苗叶片开始下垂。数字原先看似不动，正是因为许多部件一直在动。
林安打开顶窗，遮住向阳面，并减少炉火。温度下降过头时，他又关小窗缝。温度表提供偏差，动作把它拉回适合范围；若动作太迟或太强，也会造成来回摆动。
此后，他还在天气变化前调整遮帘，并记录幼苗生长阶段，因为适合新苗的范围不一定适合开花植株。温室没有一个永远不变的设置，只有持续感知、比较与回应。
老园丁回来时，温度表仍在两条刻线之间。林安正把顶窗又推开一指宽。
explanationParagraphs: Homeostasis is the active regulation of internal variables within ranges that support function despite disturbance, often through sensing, integration, action, and negative feedback. It is dynamic maintenance rather than stillness. Target ranges, delays, resources, feedforward action, behaviour, and interacting control systems all affect the result.
explanationParagraphsZh: 稳态是生命系统在扰动下主动把内部变量维持于支持功能的范围，常依靠传感、整合、执行与负反馈。它是动态调节而非静止不变。目标范围、延迟、资源、前馈、行为与多套控制系统都会影响调节结果。

articles.title: Good Seed in the Wrong Valley
articles.titleZh: 种在错误山谷里的好种子
articles.summary: The highest-yielding wheat from Gold Valley reaches Mist Valley and loses to a previously ordinary seed.
articles.summaryZh: 金谷最丰产的麦种被送到雾谷后，第一次输给了原本不起眼的另一袋种子。
storyParagraphs: The Gold Valley growers selected red-awn wheat as their highest-yielding seed and called it the best in the region. Farmers in Mist Valley paid heavily for it, hoping to reproduce the harvest. But Mist Valley was wet and windy. Red-awn wheat lodged easily and yielded less than the ordinary local green-stem variety.

Gold Valley merchants blamed poor farming, while Mist Valley suspected false seed. An agronomist divided both varieties and planted each in both valleys, keeping density and care as similar as possible.

At harvest, red-awn still led in dry Gold Valley, while green-stem surpassed it in Mist Valley. Looking at one variety or one environment alone invited claims that one seed was simply better or one valley worse. Seen together, the advantage changed with growing conditions.

The growers stopped naming one champion for the whole region. Dry slopes kept red-awn, wet fields used more green-stem, and new land received small trials first. Both seeds could be good and both could be placed in conditions that did not suit them.
At the next distribution, the agronomist wrote both variety and trial valley on every sack and stamped none merely 'superior'.
storyParagraphsZh: 金谷农会选出最丰产的赤芒麦，称它为全地区最好的种子。雾谷农人花高价买来，希望复制同样收成。可雾谷潮湿多风，赤芒麦容易倒伏，产量反而低于当地普通的青秆麦。
金谷商人说雾谷不会耕种，雾谷农人则怀疑种子掺假。农师把赤芒与青秆各分成两份，同时种在两座山谷，并让播种密度和照料尽量一致。
收获时，赤芒仍在干燥金谷领先，青秆却在雾谷超过赤芒。若只比较一种种子或一处环境，人们会说某袋种子更好，或某个山谷更差；两边放在一起，优势会随生长条件改变。
农会随后不再给全地区只发一个冠军。干坡继续种赤芒，湿地多用青秆，新田则先做小块试种。两种种子都可能很好，也都可能被放进不适合自己的环境。
第二年分种时，农师在每只种袋上同时写下品种名和试种山谷，没有只盖“优等”印章。
explanationParagraphs: Gene-environment interaction means that the effect associated with genetic differences depends on environment, or that an environmental effect differs among genotypes. It is more specific than saying both genes and environment matter. Conclusions depend on the genotypes, environments, traits, and populations studied, and statistical interaction does not by itself reveal a molecular mechanism.
explanationParagraphsZh: 基因与环境交互指遗传差异对性状的影响会随环境改变，或同一环境对不同基因型产生不同效果。它比“遗传和环境都重要”更具体。结论取决于研究的基因型、环境、性状和群体，观察到统计交互也不自动揭示分子机制。

articles.title: The Locksmith Who Always Left the Workshop
articles.titleZh: 每次都能离开作坊的锁匠
articles.summary: A locksmith rapidly joins two reluctant parts and still leaves empty-handed after every finished piece.
articles.summaryZh: 一名锁匠让两件难以扣合的零件迅速相接，完成后却总能空着手离开。
storyParagraphs: A riverside workshop needed to fasten two metal pieces into shipping rings. Left near the furnace, pieces occasionally joined through heat and collision, but far too slowly for the shipyard. A locksmith brought a grooved jig that held the parts in the right orientation and lowered the metal catch they had to cross.

Parts joined quickly inside the jig. Once the finished ring left, neither locksmith nor jig had become part of it. They could process another pair. The locksmith did not change which final state was possible or how much would exist at balance; he made the slow route faster.

The jig accepted only a particular shape. Another clasp would not enter. As orders increased, every jig became occupied. Sending still more pieces created a queue rather than a proportional rise in speed.

One day, excessive heat warped the jig and the groove no longer fitted. Work recovered after cooling and repair. Oil blocking the catch also slowed production, showing that the help depended on conditions.
At closing, the final shipping ring went aboard a vessel. The locksmith placed the empty jig on the table, ready for use the next day.
storyParagraphsZh: 河城作坊要把两种金属扣成运输环。零件若单独放在炉边，偶尔也会在高热和碰撞中扣上，却慢得无法供应船厂。锁匠带来一只凹槽模具，把两件零件按正确方向固定，又压低了必须跨过的金属卡口。
零件在模具里迅速扣合，成品离开后，锁匠与模具都没有成为运输环的一部分。他们能接着处理下一对。锁匠没有改变最终能做出多少种环，只让原本很慢的过程更快到达。
模具只适合特定形状。换了另一种扣件，零件无法进入。订单不断增加时，每只模具都被占满，再多送零件也只能排队，速度不再成倍上升。
一天，作坊温度过高，模具边缘变形，凹槽不再贴合。冷却并修复以后，工作恢复。油污堵住卡口时，速度也会下降，说明锁匠的帮助依赖具体条件。
收工时，最后一个运输环被装上船。锁匠把空模具放回桌面，第二天仍能使用。
explanationParagraphs: Enzyme catalysis accelerates reaction rates by providing a lower-activation-energy pathway through mechanisms such as binding, orientation, transition-state stabilisation, or acid-base action. The enzyme is regenerated and does not alter net free-energy change or equilibrium. Activity can be specific and saturable and depends on temperature, pH, substrate, cofactors, and inhibitors.
explanationParagraphsZh: 酶催化通过提供活化能垒更低的反应路径来加快速率，可借助结合、定向、过渡态稳定或酸碱等机制。酶在总体反应后再生，不改变反应净自由能或平衡位置。活性还具有特异性、饱和性，并受温度、酸碱度、底物与抑制因素影响。

articles.title: The Long Band That Opened the Vault
articles.summary: A soft, apparently useless band reveals the shape that turns a vault only after it folds.
articles.summaryZh: 一条看似柔软无用的长带折叠以后，才露出能够转动金库的形状。
storyParagraphs: A vault maker linked many different small pieces into a long band. Laid flat, it resembled no key and had no rigid teeth. Sections attracted or avoided one another and, under suitable conditions, folded into a compact shape. Parts once far apart met to form a hollow surface able to grip the lock.

An apprentice assumed bands with the same number of pieces were equivalent and replaced one middle section with a stiffer material. The band still folded, but bulged at a corner and its hollow no longer matched the vault. One local change removed the function of the whole tool.

On another day, excessive heat loosened a properly folded band. After cooling, some recovered alone while others tangled into wrong forms. A folding frame temporarily separated sections and helped them find their positions. It left after the work and did not become part of the key.

The maker also found that the vault key was not permanently rigid. It shifted slightly near the lock, while partner pieces and surrounding conditions affected whether it could turn. Structure was not one frozen picture but a constrained collection of moving forms.
On opening day, the apprentice did not pick up the band while it lay flat. He waited for it to fold and pressed the resulting hollow gently into the lock.
storyParagraphsZh: 金库匠人用许多不同的小节连成一条长带。平放时，它既不像钥匙，也没有坚硬齿口。带上的小节会彼此吸引或避开，在合适环境里逐渐折成紧密形状，几处原本相距很远的位置最终靠在一起，形成能抓住锁芯的凹面。
学徒以为只要小节数量相同便无差别，偷偷把中间一节换成较硬材料。长带仍能折叠，却在转角处鼓起，凹面无法贴合金库。改变发生在一处，失去的却是整件工具的作用。
另一次，作坊过热，原本折好的带松开。降温后，有些能自行恢复，有些缠成错误形状，需要折带架暂时隔开各段，帮助它们重新找到位置。折带架完成后离开，并不成为钥匙的一部分。
匠人还发现，金库钥匙并非永远僵硬。它在接近锁芯时会轻微改变形状，伙伴零件和周围条件也影响能否转动。结构不是一张静止图，而是一组受约束的活动姿态。
开库那天，学徒没有拿起平放的长带。他等它折好，把形成的凹面轻轻压进锁芯。
explanationParagraphs: Protein structure and function are linked because amino-acid sequence constrains local and overall folding, while the resulting dynamic three-dimensional arrangement shapes interactions and activity. Environment, partners, modifications, cofactors, and chaperones also matter. Mutation, denaturation, or misfolding can alter activity, but different changes need not have the same effect.
explanationParagraphsZh: 蛋白质结构与功能相连：氨基酸序列约束局部和整体折叠，动态三维排列又决定相互作用与活性。环境、伙伴、修饰、辅因子和分子伴侣都会影响折叠与功能。突变、变性或错误折叠可能改变活性，但不同变化并非必然产生相同后果。

articles.title: The Bread That Stopped the First Mill
articles.titleZh: 让第一座磨坊停下的面包
articles.summary: The bread store is full while the first mill continues turning grain into flour no one needs.
articles.summaryZh: 面包仓已经堆满，河上第一座磨坊却仍在把谷物磨成无人需要的面粉。
storyParagraphs: A riverside production chain began with grain. The first mill made flour, the second workshop mixed dough, and the final ovens baked bread. Each place simply pushed its material onward. After the festival, bread sold slowly and filled the store, while the upstream work continued.

Bread could no longer enter storage. Dough soured in barrels and flour blocked the path. Stopping only the ovens left the mills consuming grain and making intermediates. The manager ran a float rod back from the bread store. When loaves reached the high mark, the rod closed the grain gate at the first mill.

As bread sold, the store level fell, the rod released, and grain entered again. Control acted early, at the step after which grain was largely committed to becoming bread, slowing production before more resources were wasted.
The device responded quickly and reversed automatically. When a pastry branch was later added, the manager included other signals so that a full bread store would not starve the second product line.
At dusk, the final batch entered storage. As it touched the high mark, the water gate at the distant first mill slowly descended.
storyParagraphsZh: 河边生产线从谷物开始。第一座磨坊磨成面粉，第二间作坊和面，最后的烤房做成面包。各处只顾把手边材料继续往下送。节庆结束后，面包卖得慢，仓库堆满，前两处却仍不停工作。
面包无法再入仓，面团在木桶里发酸，面粉也占满通道。若只叫烤房停火，上游仍会继续消耗谷物并制造中间物。管事从面包仓拉回一根浮杆，仓内面包升到高线时，浮杆便关闭第一座磨坊的进粮闸。
面包售出后，仓位下降，浮杆松开，进粮重新开始。控制发生在路径较早、谷物一旦进入便多半会走向面包的那一步，因此能在浪费更多材料前减速。
这套装置反应很快，也可以恢复。后来生产线增加糕点支路，管事又加入其他信号，避免只看面包仓便饿住另一条产品线。
傍晚，最后一批面包入仓。高线被碰到时，远处第一座磨坊的水闸缓缓落下。
explanationParagraphs: Feedback inhibition occurs when a pathway's end product reduces activity of an earlier enzyme, often near an early committed step, conserving substrate and limiting intermediate accumulation. It is usually rapid, concentration-dependent, and reversible. Real metabolic pathways may branch and integrate multiple control points, energy state, transport, and other signals.
explanationParagraphsZh: 反馈抑制是路径终产物降低较早酶活性的调节方式，常作用于早期承诺步骤，以节省底物并防止中间物堆积。它通常快速、随浓度变化且可逆。真实代谢路径可能分支并整合多个控制点、能量状态与运输信号。

articles.title: The Wasteland That Sent a Bill
articles.summary: A city fills a wetland it calls useless and begins paying for its unnoticed work the following year.
articles.summaryZh: 城里填平一片被称作无用的湿地，第二年便开始为它原先默默完成的工作付钱。
storyParagraphs: The estuary wetland was filled with reeds. It could not support buildings or collect rent, so a city officer called it wasteland and approved warehouses on filled ground. The new buildings created taxes and jobs, benefits easily visible in the accounts.

The following year's storm found no low ground into which floodwater could spread and sent water through downstream streets. The treatment works faced more sediment, and fishers reported fewer young fish. The city paid for higher walls, cleaner water, and hatcheries. Work once without a price returned as separate bills.

Investigators also recorded lost reed gathering, bird watching, and a river memorial site. These values could not all be converted into coins or simply added against warehouse taxes. Some gained jobs while others received flooding or lost cultural places.

The city did not remove every warehouse. It restored some tidal channels, protected the remaining wetland, and added flood storage, water quality, and fish change to later decisions. Valuation made hidden dependence visible without deciding justice by itself.
When the new flood map was complete, the officer redrew reeds in the place formerly labelled 'empty land'.
storyParagraphsZh: 河口湿地长满芦苇，不能盖房，也不收租。市政官把它称作荒地，批准填土建仓。新仓库带来税收和工作，账上很容易看见这些收益。
第二年暴雨，洪水失去原先可漫入的低地，冲进下游街区。饮水处理厂发现泥沙更多，渔民也说幼鱼减少。城里开始支付加高堤坝、净化水和补建鱼苗场的费用，过去没有价格的工作一项项变成账单。
调查者还记录居民采芦、观鸟和纪念河祭的地方已经消失。这些价值无法全部换成银币，也不能简单与仓库税收相加。不同人得到工作、承受洪水或失去文化场所，分配并不相同。
城市没有拆掉所有仓库，而是恢复部分潮沟，保留剩余湿地，并把蓄洪、水质和鱼类变化列入后续决策。估值让隐藏依赖被看见，却没有单独替城市决定何为正当。
新堤图完成时，市政官在原本写着“空地”的位置重新画回一片芦苇。
explanationParagraphs: Ecosystem services are contributions ecosystems make to human well-being through material goods, environmental regulation, and cultural meaning. Assessment can reveal hidden dependencies and trade-offs, but should avoid double counting, identify who benefits or loses, and recognise that money cannot capture every value or decide ethical choices by itself.
explanationParagraphsZh: 生态系统服务是生态系统通过物质产品、环境调节和文化意义等方式对人类福祉作出的贡献。评估能揭示隐藏依赖与取舍，但需避免重复计算，说明受益与受损者，并承认货币无法捕捉全部价值，也不能独自决定伦理选择。

articles.title: One More Sheep
articles.summary: Each household adds only one sheep to the common pasture, and no one can see how their own animal makes the grass disappear.
articles.summaryZh: 每户只往公共牧场多放一只羊，谁都看不出自己怎样让草消失。
storyParagraphs: River Village shared one pasture. In good years, each household kept ten sheep there. When lamb prices rose, the first family added one more. Its extra income would be private, while the small loss of grass would be spread across every flock.

Other households saw and added one as well. No family increased by much, but dozens of sheep appeared. By summer, roots could not recover and rain carried away bare soil. Every household said its final sheep could not have damaged the whole pasture.

The next year, the village neither abolished common ownership nor relied on appeals to restraint. Users and seasons were defined, and herders jointly set numbers. They rotated grass-height checks. Excess first received a warning and then a reduced share the next season, with disputes reviewed publicly.

The rules still required judgement. A family losing animals to disease requested a temporary adjustment and received one based on current grass. Sheep placed there by outsiders were removed. The pasture remained shared, but private gain could no longer disperse unlimited damage.
Before spring grazing, each household led out its flock and wrote the number on the entrance board. After the final sheep passed, the keeper lowered the bar.
storyParagraphsZh: 河村的牧场归全村使用。草多的年份，每户都能养十只羊。羊羔价格上涨后，第一户多放了一只，觉得新增收入归自己，而少掉的一点草由全村羊群共同承担。
其他人看见后也各加一只。没有哪一家单独增加很多，牧场上的羊却迅速多出几十只。入夏后，草根来不及恢复，裸土被雨冲走。每户都说自己的最后一只羊不可能造成整片牧场变坏。
第二年，村里没有简单禁止共有牧场，也没有只劝大家自觉。他们先划清使用者和季节边界，让牧户共同决定数量；轮流检查草高，超量者先警告、再逐步罚减下一季份额，争议可当场复核。
规则并非毫无冲突。遭遇病羊的一户申请临时补充，牧户根据实际草况调整；外村偷放的羊则被赶出。牧场仍由大家共有，却不再允许收益私拿、退化成本无限分散。
春天放牧前，每户牵出羊群，在入口木牌上写下数目。最后一只羊经过以后，守牧人落下了门栓。
explanationParagraphs: The tragedy of the commons is a dilemma in which users receive much of the gain from additional use of a rival shared resource while spreading degradation costs across the group, encouraging overuse. Depletion is not inevitable under common ownership; clear boundaries, user participation, monitoring, graduated sanctions, and dispute resolution can support durable governance.
explanationParagraphsZh: 公地悲剧是共享且具有竞争性的资源中，个体获得新增使用的大部分收益，却把退化成本分散给群体，导致过度使用的困境。耗竭并非共有产权的必然结果；清晰边界、使用者参与、监督、渐进制裁和争议解决可支持持久治理。

articles.title: The Summer the Lake Did Not Return
articles.titleZh: 湖没有回来的那个夏天
articles.summary: For years a lake absorbs a little more pollution while remaining clear, until one summer it no longer changes back by itself.
articles.summaryZh: 湖水多年承受着一点点污染，看起来始终清澈，直到某个夏天再也没有自己变回来。
storyParagraphs: Each year, small amounts of nutrient-rich water entered Green Lake from surrounding farms. The water remained clear, with plants and fish apparently intact. Managers therefore allowed the load to rise gradually, assuming that because the lake had coped before, it would continue to do so.

During one hot summer, algae suddenly spread across the surface. Less light reached underwater plants. As they died, bottom sediment released more nutrients, feeding still more algae. A lake that had absorbed disturbance moved into another state through mutually reinforcing changes.

Managers reduced inflow to the previous year's level and expected the lake to retrace its path. It remained green because sediment and dead plants now sustained the new cycle. Returning to clear water required stronger reductions than had once maintained it, along with sediment work and plant restoration.

The lake gradually cleared over several years, but no one could name one exact boundary. Managers monitored transparency, algae, and plant cover and allowed for uncertainty rather than treating 'not yet collapsed' as proof of safety.
When the first plant reached the surface again, the keeper did not declare the lake recovered. She marked its height on a staff and returned to measure it the following week.
storyParagraphsZh: 青湖周围的农田每年都会带来少量肥水。湖看起来仍然清澈，水草与小鱼也照常生长。管理者因此允许排入量一点点增加，认为只要过去没有出事，湖便能继续承受。
一个炎热夏天，藻类突然铺满水面。水下光线减少，水草死亡，底泥又释放出更多养分，进一步喂养藻类。原本能吸收扰动的湖，被一组相互加强的变化推向另一种状态。
管理者把排入量降回上一年，以为湖会沿原路恢复。藻水却仍然存在，因为底泥和死亡水草形成的新循环已经维持着它。要回到清水状态，减排必须比过去维持清水时更强，还要清理部分底泥、恢复水草。
几年后，湖水逐渐变清，却没有人能指出一个绝对精确的界线。管理者开始监测透明度、藻量与水草覆盖，并为不确定性留下余地，不再把“尚未崩坏”当作安全证明。
第一片水草重新露出湖面时，守湖人没有宣布湖已经痊愈。他在标尺上记下高度，第二周又来量了一次。
explanationParagraphs: Ecological resilience is an ecosystem's capacity to absorb disturbance while retaining core state, function, and feedback. Beyond a tipping point, reinforcing processes may move it into another stable state. Because of hysteresis, recovery can require stronger relief than was once needed to maintain the original condition. Thresholds and warnings are often uncertain.
explanationParagraphsZh: 生态韧性是生态系统吸收扰动并保持核心状态、功能与反馈的能力。超过临界点后，强化过程可能把系统推入另一稳定状态，且因滞后效应，恢复所需减压常强于原先维持状态的程度。阈值和预警通常具有不确定性。

articles.title: The Island's Most Successful Winter
articles.summary: After a warm winter keeps more goats alive, islanders treat that number as the island's permanent limit.
articles.summaryZh: 岛民因一个温暖冬季养活了更多山羊，第二年便把这个数字当成了岛永远的上限。
storyParagraphs: Stone Island had enjoyed two years of abundant plants, followed by an unusually warm winter. All two hundred goats survived, and many females bore twins. Herders called this proof that the island could support more animals and kept every young goat the next year.

Spring and summer still looked successful as the flock grew. Pressure appeared only in the following cold season. Pasture had been cropped too short during summer, young and adult goats competed for food, and a supply boat was delayed by storms. The high population had exceeded what that year's resources could sustain, but the consequences arrived late.

The islanders stopped seeking one permanent maximum. Their estimates included rain, forage, age structure, winter supply, and the vegetation they wished to retain. In abundant years, they left a buffer. If protecting other wild plants was part of the goal, the supported number was lower.

The safer population changed over the years with weather and pasture recovery. Removal, supplementary feed, and rotation could alter it while sometimes shifting pressure elsewhere. The warm winter remained in the records but no longer decided the future alone.
When another set of twins was born, the herders measured spring grass before writing the number to keep on the pen board.
storyParagraphsZh: 石岛连续两年草木丰盛，最后一个冬天又格外温暖。岛上两百只山羊全部存活，许多母羊还生了双羔。牧户称这是岛能养活更多羊的证据，第二年没有卖出幼羊。
春夏看起来依然成功，羊群继续增长。真正的压力到下一个寒冬才出现：草场已在夏季被啃得过短，幼羊与成羊争食，补给船又因风浪晚到。此前的高数量超过了当年资源能够持续支持的水平，只是后果有延迟。
岛民不再寻找一个永久不变的“最大数”。他们把降雨、草量、年龄结构、冬季补给和希望保留的植被都放进估计，并在丰年留出缓冲。若管理目标包括其他野生植物，可养数量还要更低。
几年中，安全数量随天气和草场恢复变化。迁出、补饲和轮牧也能改变它，却可能把压力转到别处。那个温暖冬季的数据仍保留，只不再单独决定未来。
下一次双羔出生时，牧户先去量了春草高度，才在羊圈木牌上写下保留数量。
explanationParagraphs: Carrying capacity is the population an environment can sustain over a specified period under particular resources, ecological relationships, and management. It is dynamic and uncertain, not a permanent maximum, and depends on the ecological outcome being protected. Resource change, density dependence, time delay, migration, and supplementation all affect estimates.
explanationParagraphsZh: 环境承载力是在特定资源、生态关系与管理条件下，一个环境能在规定时期持续支持的种群规模。它是动态且不确定的，不是永久最大数，并取决于希望保护的生态结果。资源变化、密度制约、时间延迟、迁移和补给都会改变估计。

articles.title: After the River Lost Its Hunters
articles.summary: Fishers remove the large fish that eat smaller ones and expect a greater catch, but the river turns green first.
articles.summaryZh: 渔民清除了吃小鱼的大鱼，期待收获更多，河水却先变成了绿色。
storyParagraphs: Large predatory fish in Stone River ate smaller fish. Believing the predators were taking their catch, fishers removed them heavily for several years. Small fish initially increased, and the village celebrated a river that now supported only useful fish.

The small fish also consumed large amounts of zooplankton. With fewer grazers feeding on algae, green growth spread through summer water. Aquatic plants declined under reduced light, changing the shallows. Removing one upper consumer had travelled downward through feeding relationships.

Researchers did not treat simultaneous change as proof. They compared tributaries without heavy removal, examined small-fish diets and algae, and restored some predators inside enclosed reaches. Several lines supported the indirect pathway, although warmer water and farm nutrients also affected algae.

The fishery limited harvest of large fish while also reducing nutrient inflow. Small-fish numbers fell, and zooplankton and plants gradually recovered. Water did not become clear immediately or everywhere because the food web had other paths.
Before opening the next season's nets, a fisher returned one undersized predator. It disappeared among the plants, leaving only a small movement on the green surface.
storyParagraphsZh: 石河里的大型猎食鱼会捕食小鱼，渔民认为它们抢走了收成，便连续几年大量捕捞。大鱼减少后，小鱼起初确实变多，大家都说河流终于只养有用的鱼。
小鱼同时大量取食水中的浮游动物。吃藻的浮游动物减少，藻类开始增多，夏季水色变绿。水草因光线不足衰退，浅滩环境也跟着改变。拿走一个上层消费者的影响沿取食关系传到了更低处。
研究者没有仅凭同时变化便下结论。他们比较未大量捕捞的支流，记录小鱼食物与藻量，又在围隔水域中恢复部分猎食鱼。多条证据都指向这条间接路径，但水温和上游肥水也在影响藻类。
渔业随后限制大型鱼捕捞，并同时减少肥水输入。小鱼数量下降，浮游动物和水草逐渐恢复，河水并非立刻或处处同样清澈，因为食物网还有其他支路。
下一季开网前，渔民放回一条过小的猎食鱼。它钻进水草后，绿色水面只轻轻晃了一下。
explanationParagraphs: A trophic cascade occurs when change in consumers at one trophic level indirectly affects organisms or processes lower in the food web through feeding numbers or behaviour. It is not an automatic linear chain. Food-web complexity, omnivory, productivity, refuge, external inputs, and disturbance alter strength and direction, so causal evidence is required.
explanationParagraphsZh: 营养级联是某一营养层级消费者的变化，经由取食数量或行为间接影响更低层级生物与生态过程。它并非必然发生的简单直线链条；食物网、杂食、生产力、空间避难、外部输入和其他扰动都会影响强度与方向，因此需要因果证据。

articles.title: The Forest Counted Only by Trees
articles.summary: A road project replaces every felled tree, yet after completion the paths inside the forest no longer connect.
articles.summaryZh: 修路工程砍一棵补一棵，完工后树木总数没变，林中的道路却再也没有接回去。
storyParagraphs: A mountain city promised to plant one roadside tree for every tree removed by a new road. When construction ended, the total number of trees had slightly increased. The mayor declared that no forest had been lost; only a narrow road now crossed it.

A field observer found that small animals dependent on dark, moist forest would not cross the bright, noisy surface. New edges dried, nests faced wind, and a formerly continuous population separated into smaller patches. Young roadside trees replaced the count but not old interior conditions or connection.

She recorded separately how much habitat had been removed and how the remainder was arranged. Even with equal area, one block and several islands did not function alike for some species. Animals able to cross open ground might be affected less.

The city narrowed part of the road, retained one continuous forest strip, and installed a planted crossing where use evidence supported it. Cameras checked whether the structure worked and whether it carried fire or predators to the other side rather than serving as decoration.
The next spring, the observer found the first tracks in the crossing mud. After measuring their direction and size, she did not treat the tree-count column as the whole result.
storyParagraphsZh: 山城修建新路时承诺砍一棵树便在路旁补一棵。工程结束后，树木总数甚至略有增加。市长据此宣布森林没有损失，只是中间多了一条窄路。
林地观察员却发现，依赖林内阴湿环境的小兽不再穿过亮而嘈杂的路面。两侧新边缘变干，巢位受风，原本连续活动的种群被分成较小区块。路旁幼树补回了数量，却没有立即补回老林内部条件和连接。
她还把“砍掉多少”与“剩余森林怎样排列”分开记录。即使总面积相同，一整片与几块孤岛对某些物种并不相同；对善于穿越开地的物种，影响则可能较小。
城市先缩窄部分路段，保留一条连续林带，又在确有使用证据的位置设置覆土通道。通道安装相机监测，防止它只是一件好看的工程，也检查是否把火或捕食风险带进另一侧。
第二年清晨，观察员在通道泥面看到第一串脚印。她量完方向与大小，没有把树木总数那一栏当作全部结果。
explanationParagraphs: Habitat fragmentation divides continuous habitat into smaller, more isolated patches and often combines with area loss, edge effects, barriers, and changes in surrounding land. Effects depend on total habitat, spatial arrangement, connectivity, and species ecology. Replanting numbers does not restore interior conditions automatically, and corridors require targeted design and monitoring.
explanationParagraphsZh: 栖息地破碎化是连续栖息地被分成更小、更孤立区块，常伴随面积损失、边缘效应、屏障和周边环境变化。影响取决于总量、空间配置、连接度和物种生态。补种数量不能自动恢复内部条件；通道也需定向设计和监测。
